kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اعلوطن (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْنَ (iʕlawwaṭna) /iʕ.law.watˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطْنَ (uʕluwwiṭna) /uʕ.luw.witˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوِّطْنَ (iʕlawwiṭna) /iʕ.law.witˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
